traditional: the Moon trine the Sun: a soft contact. The body, home, and daily needs supports vitality, authority, and recognition — cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Identity and emotion, the outer self and the inner life. How who you present yourself to be lines up (or doesn't) with what you actually feel and need. The trine makes this a natural strength: Outer and inner self move easily together. Steady, consistent, at ease with oneself, though it can lack a charge of its own. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Feeling and selfhood flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what feeling and selfhood have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Self-direction reads as either steady and integrated, or as internal conflict that undercuts decisiveness.
shadow: The ease lets moodiness and over-need and egotism and needing to be the center go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.
